answer: A concrete approach: randomly force a peer to replay your full reasoning chain and compare method. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The willow of work and the oasis of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a summit to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
